delivery_target: Callers that hold valid_table_caps and page_table_at but not the specific cap equality
new_lemma:
lemma valid_table_caps_ptD_no_cap:
  "\<lbrakk> page_table_at p' s; valid_table_caps s \<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow>
    \<exists>pt. ko_at (ArchObj (PageTable pt)) p' s \<and> valid_vspace_obj (PageTable pt) s"
  apply (clarsimp simp: valid_table_caps_def simp del: split_paired_All)
  apply (erule allE)+
  apply (erule (1) impE)
  apply (clarsimp simp add: is_pt_cap_def cap_asid_def)
  apply (erule impE, rule refl)
  apply (clarsimp simp: obj_at_def empty_table_def)
  done
rationale: The scanner notes `caps_of_state` never appears literally in the proof body; the expansion via valid_table_caps_def drives the argument. If valid_table_caps internally existentially quantifies over caps referencing p', the page_table_at witness alone may be enough to trigger the required obj_at (empty_table) fact without an explicit caps_of_state equality. Low confidence but costs only one trial.
strengthening_claim: (page_table_at p' s \<and> valid_table_caps s) \<Longrightarrow> (caps_of_state s p = Some (ArchObjectCap (arch_cap.PageTableCap p' None)) \<and> page_table_at p' s \<and> valid_table_caps s)
